title: Balanced Binary Tree
kidExplanation: Picture the puzzle 'Balanced Binary Tree'. Here is the clever trick in plain words: To check if a binary tree is balanced, we can use a recursive approach. For each node, we calculate the height of its left and right subtrees. If the difference in heights is greater than 1, the tree is not balanced. thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To check if a binary tree is balanced, we can use a recursive approach. For each node, we calculate the height of its left and right subtrees. If the difference in heights is greater than 1, the tree is not balanced. We continue this process for all nodes, recursively checking each subtree.
